2) Start at 9:00, run a condensed loop (Intro 10m / PM 20m / Eng 20m) and plan a 20m synchronous debrief immediately after. Lauren can drop at ~9:10, Evelyn can pick up the product questions after Lauren leaves. Sergio, I can take notes and run debrief.
3) If we can6t do either, we record a short intro and have Samira join for the core interviews.

I6m attaching the Interview Notes template and a short checklist for condensed loops. I can cover any gaps in product if Lauren needs to leave early.

Attachment: Interview_Notes_Template.docx

If everyone replies now, I6ll update the calendar and send an adjusted calendar link.

— Marissa
